input_contract.independent_oracle: Float64 normalized-axis quaternion by negative repeat*Float32angle, not replicated matrix coefficients
input_contract.scope: Signed unit vectors, zero and six signed basis witnesses; finite declared source-rounded axis and exact z axis. Not arbitrary nonunit axes, original random-seed identity, or all-angle certification.
input_contract.budget: Predeclared finite-case absolute 5e-6+8e-7*R; allows Float32 axis norm and repeated arithmetic/SFU rounding. Not formal all-input error bound.
input_contract.invariants: Full xyz versus quaternion plus norm/axis-projection <=3*pointwisebudget; float4 fourth field exact positive zero; input/parameter/guards exact
input_contract.timing: Sum24 separate host launch/contextcompletion windows, each divided by R; in-place across repeats, fresh buffer per case outside ROI; JIT/readback/reset outside. Five trials, average2-5.
